parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A long, straight wire carries a current into the page, as shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1}}

Fig. 7.1

On Fig. 7.1, draw four field lines to represent the magnetic field around the wire due to the current in it.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Explain why the two wires exert a magnetic force on each other.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: On Fig. 7.2, draw an arrow to show the direction of the magnetic force exerted on wire $X$. Label your arrow $F$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
The current in $X$ is double the current in $Y$.

State how the magnetic force exerted on wire $Y$ compares with the magnetic force exerted on wire $X$.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text:
The direction of the current in both wires is now reversed.

State, with a reason, the effect of this change on the direction of the force on wire $X$.
